source: import {nextTick,ref,useTemplateRef,watch} from 'vue'; const props=defineProps<{text:string}>(); const areaRef=ref<HTMLTextAreaElement|null>(null); const list=useTemplateRef<HTMLUListElement>('list'); watch(()=>props.text,async()=>{ await nextTick(); const el=areaRef.value; if(el){el.style.height='auto';el.style.height=`${el.scrollHeight}px`;} const ul=list.value;if(ul)ul.scrollTop=0; });
import {ref,shallowRef} from 'vue'; const state=ref({count:0}); const shallow=shallowRef({count:0}); function bump(){const s=state.value;s.count=1;const t=shallow.value;t.count=1;}
import {ref} from 'vue'; const state=ref(['a']); function mutate(){ const tags=state.value;tags.push('b');tags.splice(0,1);}
import {shallowRef} from 'vue'; const state=shallowRef(['a']); function mutate(){ const tags=state.value;tags.push('b');}
import {ref,markRaw} from 'vue';const raw=markRaw({count:0});const state=ref(raw);function bump(){const s=state.value;s.count++;}

import {ref as useRef,useTemplateRef as templateNode} from 'vue';const state=useRef({count:0});const node=templateNode('node');function bump(){const s=state.value;s.count++;const el=node.value;el.scrollTop=0;}

import {ref,shallowRef} from 'vue';const state=ref({count:0});function inner(){const state=shallowRef({count:0});const snap=state.value;snap.count++;}function outer(){const snap=state.value;snap.count++;}

import {ref,shallowRef} from 'vue';const state=shallowRef({count:0});function inner(){const state=ref({count:0});const snap=state.value;snap.count++;}function outer(){const snap=state.value;snap.count++;}
import {ref} from 'vue';const state=ref({count:0});const shared=state.value;function inner(state){shared.count++;const copy=shared;copy.count++;}
